why: The engine's venue table is part of the trained parameter set and covers the FBS field the model was built on (2025). A programme that moves up from the FCS, or a school that opens a new stadium, is therefore absent from it until the parameters are retrained — and an absent venue is an absent weather forecast, because a forecast is located by coordinates. This file is the injection point for those, and it is deliberately not a place to guess: an entry without a real latitude, a real longitude and a named source is REFUSED by football/matchup/inputs.js and reported as refused. Nothing here is interpolated from a city name.
how_to_add: Add one entry keyed by the team's canonical key (lower-case, alphanumerics only: `missouristate`). Required: lat, lon, source (where the coordinates came from, as a URL or a named public dataset). Optional: name, elev (metres), tz (UTC offset hours), dome (boolean), grass (boolean), capacity. Run `node football/fbs/build_coverage.js` and the game's weather field moves from UNAVAILABLE to a real state.
source: published stadium coordinates, one named source per entry; `verified_at` is when EdgeDesk last checked the entry against that source
resolver: football/venues/resolve_venues.js lists every venue the current slate needs and refuses any candidate it cannot corroborate against a second independent source

missouristate.name: Robert W. Plaster Stadium
missouristate.corroboration_note: the two published points differ by roughly 0.7 km, well inside the open-meteo forecast grid, so they agree for the purpose this coordinate is used for. The Wikipedia value is the one carried.
missouristate.why_needed: Missouri State moved up to FBS after the parameter table's trained venue set was built, so the trained table has no entry for it and every forecast join for a Missouri State home game failed for want of a coordinate.

sacramentostate.name: Hornet Stadium
sacramentostate.corroboration_note: the school's own facilities page gives the address 6000 J Street, Sacramento, which is the same site as the published coordinate.
sacramentostate.why_needed: Sacramento State is new to the FBS field the parameter table was trained on, so the trained table has no entry for it.
